Metadata.title: CV Simple | Create a one-page resume
Metadata.description: Create and download a professional resume in PDF and DOCX without storing your personal data.

App.myCvsDescription: Save different versions of your resume in this browser, such as one in English and another in Spanish.
App.cvNameHelp: Use a name to distinguish versions in the same language or different templates. If left empty, one will be generated automatically.
App.cvSaveError: The resume could not be saved in this browser.
App.noSavedCvs: You have not saved any resumes yet
App.noSavedCvsHelp: Resumes you save will appear here and remain only in this browser.
App.libraryLoadError: Saved resumes could not be loaded.
App.heroTitle: Create a resume that gets to the point.
App.heroDescription: Add only what matters. The preview and files are generated on this device.
App.confirmRestoreHelp: All information currently shown in the editor will be replaced. If autosave is enabled, the draft or open resume will also be updated.
App.name: Name
App.photoHelp: JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB. Processed locally.
App.colorsHelp: Customize the palette without changing the resume structure or layout.
App.sectionOrderHelp: Drag sections to reorder them in the preview, PDF, and DOCX. Contact and Languages remain in the sidebar.
App.achievements: Achievements and responsibilities · up to 4 bullets
App.privacyNotice: We don't use accounts, databases, or personal data storage. Closing or refreshing this tab will discard your changes.
App.autoSaveOnHelp: Your changes are stored only on this device. Turning it off deletes the automatic draft but keeps resumes saved in My resumes.
App.autoSaveOffHelp: It is disabled. Save the resume to My resumes before closing the tab if you want to keep it.
App.autoSaveDisabled: Autosave disabled and draft deleted. Your saved resumes were kept.
App.autoSaveError: This browser does not have enough space to store the resume. Autosave was disabled.
App.localPrivacyReminder: Your data and photo are processed on this device and are not sent to our servers.
App.downloadPrivacy: It is generated in your browser; your data is never sent to a server.
App.editedDocx: Did you edit the DOCX after downloading it?
App.editedDocxHelp: If you made changes in Word, you can convert that modified version back to PDF.
App.externalNotice: This link opens iLovePDF, an external service with its own terms and privacy policy.
App.generationError: The file could not be generated. Check the fields and try again.
App.imageError: Use a JPG or PNG image up to 2 MB.
